features.rationale: The heading 'All in One' together with the hotel section and the 4 days and 4 nights party event suggests the parties take place in the hotel where dancers stay.
The description explicitly advertises workshops with international teachers as part of the event.
The pass list states there are more than thirty workshops included.
The event offers four social parties, which are daytime socials distinct from the night parties.
The pass includes access to four social rooms, meaning more than one dance room.
